notes.title: Profiteer Version 6.0
notes.content:
Hey,
We have finally updated our game to the newest version, in this version we added:
[list]
[*]New tutorial section, some players were complaining about understanding of the game, so we added more explanations in our tutorial
[*]Fixed Portuguese and Portuguese-Brazil Localization mistakes
[*]Small UI additions
[*]Smaller bug fixes, which led to better game feel
[/list]

What is in our plans:
[list]
[*]We are planning to add new 3D models and visuals
[*]Some mechanics will be upgraded and balanced better
[*]Some secret things so keep in touch
[/list]

Thanks!

notes.title: Release!
notes.content:
🛠️ [b]Profiteer Now Available![/b] 🛠️

Dear Profiteers,

We are thrilled to announce that [b]Profiteer [/b]has officially launched today, October 7th! 🗓️ The wait is over, and you can now dive into the game!

[b]To celebrate the launch, Profiteer is available with a 15% discount for a limited time! [/b]🎉 Don’t miss the chance to be one of the first players to build your empire at a discounted price.

[b]✨ Key features at launch:[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Optimized gameplay:[/b] Maximize profits with minimalist graphics and simple mechanics that prioritize strategic depth over complexity.
[*] [b]Diverse resources:[/b] Manage Minerals, Wood, Oil, and Labor to outpace your competitors.
[*] [b]Challenging AI:[/b] Face off against a smart AI that ensures every victory feels rewarding.
[*] [b]Dynamic world:[/b] Enjoy random world generation and multiple map settings for a fresh experience every game.
[*] [b]CO-OP Gameplay:[/b] Team up with friends to dominate the market together.
[*] [b]Additional features:[/b] Day/night cycles, immersive factory sounds, and other small details to bring the world to life.
[*] [b]🚀 Early Access Info: [/b]Stay tuned for updates on Early Access features, community engagement, and feedback opportunities!
[/list]

[b]💬 Join the Conversation:[/b] Connect with our community on Discord to discuss strategies, share feedback, and interact with fellow players.

Thank you for your support and patience! We can't wait to see your strategies in action.

Happy trading,
[b]Team Hrust[/b]

notes.title: Profiteer Release Date
notes.content:
🛠️ [b]Profiteer Release Date Announcement![/b] 🛠️

Dear Profiteers,

We are thrilled to finally announce that Profiteer will officially launch on [b]October 7th[/b]! 🗓️ Mark your calendars, as the wait is almost over!

✨ [b]Key Features at Launch:[/b]
[list]
[*] Streamlined Gameplay: Maximize profits with minimalistic graphics and straightforward mechanics that emphasize strategic depth over complexity.
[*] Diverse Resources: Manage four essential resources: Minerals, Wood, Oil, and Work-force to optimize your economic growth and outmaneuver competitors.
[*] Challenging AI: Face off against a smart AI that anticipates your moves, ensuring each victory is both hard-fought and rewarding.
[*] Dynamic World: Enjoy varied playthroughs with random world generation and multiple map settings, ensuring no two games are the same.
[*] CO-OP Gameplay: Partner with friends in cooperative mode, combining your strategic minds to dominate the market together.
[*] Extra Features: Experience the day and night cycle, hear the sounds of industry when your camera is near a factory, and discover other small details that bring the world of Profiteer to life.
[/list]

🚀[b] Launch Plans & Early Access Info:[/b] We're entering the final stages of development and will be sharing more detailed updates on Early Access, including community involvement, bug reporting, and feedback mechanisms. Stay tuned for a closer look at gameplay mechanics, ship classes, and more exclusive content.

💬 [b]Join the Conversation:[/b] We invite you to join our growing community in the discord to discuss strategies, share your feedback, and connect with fellow entrepreneurs.

Thank you for your patience and continued support. We can't wait to see you in game, hustling for profit and glory!

Happy trading, The Hrust Team

notes.title: Updating Profiteer to version 3.0
notes.content:
Hey,
We are currently updated our game to the newer version and we added some new mechanics and don't forget to wishlist our game!

[b]What's new:[/b]
[list]
[*]Firstly we have added new mechanic, this is an ability of buildings to broke down after some period of time
[*]We also added some UI which will indicate breaking down as well as some particles
[*]We also found some people to help us with translation of our game into different languages
[*]And last but not least, we have fixed several bugs which were occuring
[/list]

[b]Planned:[/b]
[list]
[*]We are starting to work on co-op for our game
[*]We are planning to add some new mechanics
[*]And some new smaller features also in development
[/list]

Thanks for the reading!
